title: Expected Attention: KV Cache Compression by Estimating Attention from Future Queries Distribution
quote: our method requires users to specify compression ratios manually
proves: §7 identifies manual ratios, lightweight tuning, and custom CUDA kernels as open work for this method.
does_not_prove: Adaptive compression in general remains open.

title: KVzap: Fast, Adaptive, and Faithful KV Cache Pruning
quote: KVzap is trained on prompts limited to 1,250 tokens.
proves: Appendix A flags possible train-test shift. §4 leaves wall-clock implementation and broader architecture and agent tests open.
does_not_prove: Long-context generalization fails, or every compressed KV pair becomes physically free.

title: Inference-Time Hyper-Scaling with KV Cache Compression
quote: the verifier’s complexity is quadratic in the sequence length
proves: The authors identify verifier prefill as a distinct cost when regenerating or selecting reasoning paths. Appendix A also proposes other attention variants and retrieval.
does_not_prove: KV-cache reads predict end-to-end cost in a system with a verifier.

title: KV Prediction for Improved Time to First Token
quote: When experimenting with KV Prediction, we use OpenELM
proves: §3 studies an auxiliary predictor paired with OpenELM, and the abstract identifies M2 Pro CPU timing.
does_not_prove: Predicted KV is equivalent to original KV, or identical TTFT gains occur on a batched GPU.

title: TurboQuant: Online Vector Quantization with Near-optimal Distortion Rate
quote: resulting in an unbiased inner product quantizer
proves: Algorithm estimates inner products and is tested on retrieval and LongBench.
does_not_prove: Exact semantic tool arguments are preserved.

title: Practical Online KV Cache Compaction for LLM Agents: An Empirical Study
quote: we evaluate fixed compaction ratios and delay windows rather than adaptive policies
proves: Limitations explicitly propose adaptive timing and budgets and identify state-changing tasks as outside evaluation.
does_not_prove: A change of algorithm or task necessarily gives stronger efficiency or accuracy.

title: ActKV: Efficient LLM Agents through Action-Guided KV Cache Management
proves: §3.2 conditions the confidence-budget study on successful dense runs. §6 uses a confidence trend to grow the budget before compression.
does_not_prove: An alarm precedes a wrong argument or identifies compression as its cause.

title: Constrained Decoding Can Reverse Which Inputs Look Uncertain
quote: The reversal is confined to the first generated token and disappears once the prompt asks for the format
proves: An observed pre/post-mask entropy ordering depends on prompt and position in this controlled refusal study.
does_not_prove: Reversal occurs for exact argument values, eviction, or ActKV's score.

title: kv-exec-bench
quote: the parse rate never drops below 1.00 while schema validity falls by half or more
proves: A 0.5B CPU pilot already contrasts parseability with a stronger tool-call metric after eviction.
does_not_prove: Larger models have the same error rate, or an early warning is possible.

title: ExactKV technical report
quote: it generates confidently incorrect JSON at a different structural level than the full-KV path
proves: A tech report describes a concrete structural divergence and full-KV verification in a model-specific test.
does_not_prove: Semantic false-alarm detection at a fixed replay cost under action-oriented eviction.

title: Add TensorRT-LLM runtime integration for KV cache compression
quote: pushed both capacity and history back to the logical token count
proves: Merged runtime work explicitly separates physical cache length and logical token position.
does_not_prove: It integrates KVzap or ActKV specifically.

title: KV Cache Compression Development Guide
quote: state whether the comparison holds physical bytes or logical Page capacity constant
proves: Upstream explicitly requires physical-vs-logical accounting and whole-model quality tests.
does_not_prove: One policy preserves quality at a given byte budget.

title: MetaKV: Adaptive KV Cache Compression for Constrained LLM Inference
quote: a single fixed configuration unsuitable across different prompts and resource constraints
proves: Examines selecting compression configurations under resource constraints.
does_not_prove: Grammar-constrained action confidence or an online early alarm.

title: SCBench: A KV Cache-Centric Analysis of Long-Context Methods
quote: we use ground-truth answers instead of model-generated content as the context for follow-up turns
proves: The multi-turn protocol isolates the method’s behavior given a correct history.
does_not_prove: How a wrong answer feeds into a subsequent tool action in a free-running trajectory.

title: gpt-oss-120b & gpt-oss-20b Model Card
quote: attention blocks alternate between banded window and fully dense patterns
proves: §2.2 specifies a 128-token window and a distinct long-context dense layer. Figure 2 evaluates developer function calls on τ-Bench.
does_not_prove: How compression changes argument correctness, or that every layer retains the full prefix.
